title: commutating
description: The coherence morphism of an aperiodic settling: it asserts that the past-facing nucleus saturating (sigma) and the future-facing nucleus transferring (Delta) on the same settled fiber Heyting algebra commute, sigma . Delta = Delta . sigma, the aperiodic-regime KZ-diamond hinge whose commuting square produces the four-corner quartet.

morphism.description: a one-way generative arrow; asserts sigma . Delta = Delta . sigma so the composite is again a nucleus with doubly-quiescent fixed-point layer A* = Fix(sigma) intersect Fix(Delta)

domain.description: the aperiodic settling carrying the two commuting nuclei it maps out of

codomain.description: the aperiodic-nuclear-quartet-category whose objects are commutative nuclear squares (A, sigma, Delta) with four-corner structure (A, Fix(sigma), Fix(Delta), A*)
